entries.note: The sender's own draft of the consignment, just before Shipment Data Received. The tracker hides the row and the adapter leaves it out.
The sender's data has arrived; the tracker's progress bar calls it Data Received.
Seen only as an undated step, which the adapter skips.
On board the delivery vehicle; the tracker shows it as On Board.
The tracker's label for On Board For Delivery, between In Transit and Delivered on its progress bar.
A status Quick Track's script defines beside Partially Delivered - Final: some units are delivered and the rest are on their way.
